comparator.sourceNotes: Open Universiteit offers this Dutch-taught degree part-time. It comprises 55 EC of compulsory foundation courses, 65 EC of later taught courses, 15 EC of restricted electives, 30 EC of free electives and a 15 EC graduation project.

alternativeSelection.assessment: The closest plan combines information technology, organizations, accounting and research. The analytics plan emphasizes statistics, quantitative modeling and machine learning. The technical plan emphasizes software, networks and advanced algorithms. Privacy and responsible deployment receive substantive treatment across the plans, while dedicated information security, enterprise modeling, ontology and specialist project preparation remain gaps.

comparisonAlignment.rationale: Both introduce computing. UCR concentrates on programming and computational problem solving.
Both study logic, sets, relations and formal reasoning.
Both develop object-oriented programming. UCR also introduces functional programming.
Open Universiteit requires dedicated software engineering. UCR teaches related development practices in a broader course.
Open Universiteit teaches enterprise modeling as a dedicated subject.
The UCR plans explore information science through courses in computing, data and organizations.
Both study relational database design and SQL.
Both develop communication for different audiences. Open Universiteit includes professional practice.
Open Universiteit teaches information security as a dedicated subject. UCR covers privacy and accountability in Ethics of AI.
Open Universiteit teaches object-oriented analysis and design. UCR’s product course addresses user needs and prototyping.
Open Universiteit offers dedicated study of representing domain knowledge.
Both use data analysis to inform decisions. UCR develops general data analysis techniques.
Both develop statistical inference. UCR also provides a mathematical treatment of probability.
Both develop research design and evidence analysis. Open Universiteit requires 60 EC of foundation study, including the academic skills course, before its 10 EC methods course.
Both examine how AI affects people and organizations. UCR emphasizes business and economic effects.
Both study behavior, motivation and teams in organizations.
Both address budgeting, costing and performance. UCR also covers financial accounting and investment appraisal.
Both examine how organizations operate. UCR approaches this through business foundations.
Open Universiteit requires a course on setting up and managing projects.
Both develop ethical reasoning. Open Universiteit focuses specifically on digital innovation.
Both examine organizational strategy and technology adoption. UCR focuses on digital transformation.
Both develop academic inquiry and communication.

Complete preparation immediately before the supervised 15 EC project. UCR offers optional independent research outside the scheduled degree.
Choose three courses from six approved analytics and innovation electives.
